# Draugr Elite trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophyDraugrElite | Source: Draugr elite | Usage: Crafting, Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

The Draugr Elite trophy is a rare drop from Draugr elite in the Swamp.

### Crafting

• Iron sledge

### Misc

• Can be displayed in an Item Stand.
• Can be used to program the Ballista.

Categorias: Trophies, Materials
